title: Cliff Wong on faking an orb with a drone-towed balloon

tellings.quote:
I talked to, uh, this guy Cliff Wong,
who was the world's expert on drones,
and I said, "If you wanted to fake X, Y,
or Z, how would you do it?" And so he
told me,

plain: A guest on a podcast, Eric Hazeline, says he once asked a man named Cliff Wong, whom he calls the world's expert on drones, how someone would go about faking various kinds of sightings. Hazeline says Wong told him how it could be done, and the story is about faking an orb, a glowing ball seen in the sky, with a balloon pulled along by a drone. If true, it would show how some orb sightings could be staged.
